RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the March 13, 2006/Phalguna 22, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agro and Rural Industries; Communications and Information
Technology; Development of North Eastern Region; Human Resource
Development;  Information and Broadcasting;  Law and Justice;
Mines; Minority Affairs; Parliamentary Affairs; Small Scale
Industries; Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal
Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Setting up of electronic telephone
exchanges in Jammu and Kashmir
*301. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the numbers of electronic telephone
exchanges set up and functioning in Jammu
and Kashmir at present;
(b) whether some more such exchanges
are likely to be opened in near future; and
(c) if so, the details thereof, location-
wise?
Welfare of minorities
†*302. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to implement a 15 point programme for
the welfare of minorities;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Financial support by IIAS, Shimla
*303. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Institute of Advanced Study, Shimla was
actively involved with financial support in
patronising a religious ceremony in which
Brahmins were given dakshinas as reported
in the findings of the Review Committee
set up by Government to look into the
affairs of the IIAS;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
take action against the authorities of IIAS
for vitiating the functions of IIAS;
(d) if so, the details of the action
proposed to be taken; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

95
Improvement in connectivity of
mobile phones
*304. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
improve the mobile phone line connectivity
in the country;
(b) if so, whether Government have
formulated any scheme for this purpose;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have any
target for increasing mobile phone lines in
the country during the current year;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the position of mobile phone line
connectivity as on January, 2006?
Programmes of DD and AIR
*305. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Doordarshan Kendra
and All India Radio are producing regular
programmes including song, music and
news bulletin in all recognised Indian
languages;
(b) whether programmes in some
languages, which are recognised by the State
but not by the Centre, are also produced in
regular or casual manner; and
(c) if so, the details of the nature of
programmes?
Schemes of education of SC/ST and
OBC students
*306. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of schemes being
implemented for SC/ST and OBC
candidates for their primary, secondary and
higher education;
(b) the details thereof alongwith the
allocation of funds provided under each
category during the last two years; and
(c) the funds utilised in each category,
year-wise?
Implementation of Tribal
Development Project
*307. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA : Will the Minister of TRIBAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Integrated Tribal
Development Projects being implemented
in Rajasthan, alongwith the details thereof;
(b) the amount provided by
Government to each of these projects
during the last three years and the amount
actually spent thereon;
(c) the projects out of the above which
have been completed;
(d) if so, the achievements thereof;
(e) whether any proposal under ITDP
from the State Government are still pending
for consideration with the Centre; and
(f) if so, the details and status thereof?
Reach of DD-India
*308. SHRIMATI KAMLA MANHAR:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether after the recent visit of the

96
Prime Minister to USA, UK and the Middle
East, Doordarshan has conducted a study
on the impact and reach of Doordarshan
India (DD-India) channel;
(b) whether it is a fact that tenders were
invited for conducting feasibility study for
these countries and companies have been
short-listed;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether despite PMO's instructions
and tenders specification, letter of offer has
been issued only for Middle East; and
(e) if so, what are the reasons for not
issuing letter of offer for USA and UK and
steps being taken for include them as
prescribed in the tender document?
Increase in number of Notaries in
Kerala
*309. SHRI N.K. PREMACHANDRAN:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Kerala has sought the sanction to enhance
the number of Notaries, considering the
special circumstances prevailing in the
State;
(b) whether Government propose to
enhance the number of Notaries, as
requested; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not
the reasons therefor?
Scheme for development of primitive
tribal groups
*310. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the aims and the objectives of the
Development of Primitive Tribal Groups
Scheme run by Government;
(b) whether the above Scheme is
implemented in the State of Andhra
Pradesh;
(c) if so, the details of tribal groups
covered in Andhra Pradesh, district-wise;
(d) whether the pathetic condition of
Chenchu, a primitive tribal from Mahaboob
Nagar district has come to the notice of
Government; and
(e) if so, the steps Government have
taken for the welfare and upliftment of
these primitive tribals in the last five years?
Publishing of telephone directories
*311. SHRIMATI JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number and names of cities other
than metros for which MTNL brings out
telephone directories;
(b) when were the last directories
brought out in respect of these cities;
(c) whether it is a fact that for the last
several years, no telephone directories have
been brought out in respect of these cities,
if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) by when the next issue of telephone
directories is likely to be brought out?
Rent-free connections by BSNL
*312. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether BSNL has made all the
landline connections rent free;
(b) if so, since when;
(c) whether the same facility is

97
proposed to be provided by MTNL in
Delhi and Mumbai; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Funds for private telecom operators
for rural telephony
*313. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have planned
to provide funds to private operators to
create telecom infrastructure in rural
areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any target has been fixed
for those operators to provide telephone
facilities in rural areas;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Nuns as lawyers
*314. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Karnataka
High Court has ordered that Nuns cannot
be lawyers;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Nuns are eligible to acquire
a degree in law;
(d) if so, the reasons for denying them
the right to make use of their qualifications;
and
(e) the steps Government propose in
this regard?
Autonomous colleges
*315. PROF. P.J. KURIAN : Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
give permission for more autonomous
colleges;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) the number of such autonomous
colleges in the State of Kerala?
Inclusion of "Autism" under
Disability Act
†*316. SHRI VASANT CHAVAN: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the persons suffering from
mental disorders such as "Autism" have
not been included in the 'Persons with
Disability Act;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the relevant clauses of the Act
in which this disease has been included
alongwith the details thereof?
Scholarship to engineering students
*317. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether schemes are under
implementation by Government to provide
merit scholarship to engineering students;
(b) if so,the details thereof including the
number of  students being given scholarship,
State-wise, and the eligibility criteria laid
down therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that the number
of scholarships being given is far less
considering the size of the country; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

98
(d) if so, the steps proposed to be taken
to increase the number of scholarships in
engineering field?
Development of sick SSIs
*318. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
recent RBI report stating that increasing
incidences of SSIs declaring themselves sick
is a reason for slowing growth of flow of
bank credit to the sector;
(b) whether Government are of the view
that the trend may lead to drying up of a
major source of financial assistance to the
SSIs in the country; and
(c) whether any plans have been
formulated or steps being taken to increase
and promote the credit and loan sources
for development of SSI sector in India?
Voluntary organisations engaged in
welfare of orphans and destitutes
*319. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the voluntary
organisations working for welfare of
orphans and destitute children especially
among the tribals in Jharkhand, indicating
places and the nature of activity the
respective organisations engaged therein and
the estimated number of beneficiaries;
(b) the details of funds provided by
Government to each organisation during the
last five years, year-wise;
(c) whether any organisation has been
black-listed during the period; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, including
action taken against them?
Shortage of skilled human and
educational resources
*320. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
is facing shortage of both skilled human
resources and educational resources;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) the details of the steps taken by
Government for higher education in the
country?

under PMRY

steps to create extra job opportunities in
non-farm sector under the PMRY;

in Andhra Pradesh during the last two years;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Scheme for poor villagers

the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:

poor villagers so that they don't have to
take loan from bank;

launch any scheme from its own funds for

industries; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Applications received under PMRY

by the said scheme, State-wise; and
(c) the efforts made by Government to
make the said scheme more result oriented?

(c) whether MTNL has to recover more
than Rs. 700 crores from its consumers;
and

(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken by MTNL to recover the said
amount?

the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS

be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
the report by McKinsey, India is required
to produce 23 lakh technology experts by
the year 2010 to maintain its superiority in
IT and Business Process Outsourcing;
(b) whether it is also a fact that India is
short by 5 lakh tech-experts so as to meet
the demand; and
(c) if so, what long-term and short-term
plans Government and NASSCOM have
to meet this demand by 2010?

crimes

NATCHIAPPAN: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND

pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
amend the Information Technology Act to
meet the increase in cyber crimes;
(b) if so, the sections identified for
making amendments; and
(c) if not, whether Government are
contemplating to study the problems faced
by the industry due to cyber crimes?

services

service?

subscribers

2004-05 and 2005-06;

to MTNL in the last two years in Delhi
and Mumbai respectively;
(c) the reasons for the poor service of
MTNL;
(d) how does MTNL propose to
improve its various services; and
(e) the steps taken in this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

grounds in BSNL and MTNL

Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether appointment on
compassionate grounds of the wards of
deceased officers/employees has been
stopped in the MTNL and BSNL;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether there is an acute shortage of
staff in MTNL and BSNL;
(d) whether vacancies caused due to the

(e) if so, the steps being taken by

compassionate grounds?

infrastructure

Will the Minister of COMMUNI-

propose to fund telecom companies to
create telecom infrastructure in rural India

companies

Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be

operators?

(d) what action Government have taken
in this regard?

Scheme

SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:

LAXMAN NAIK:

TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the MTNL and BSNL

(b) if so, the details of the scheme; and

BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-

cognizance of the recent study by the

cognizance of other independent report on

the resources for this?

MEENA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have asked the
Telecom Regulator to issue regulation on
Access Deficit Charge (ADC) to the
Cellular Operators at the earliest while
Cellular Operators Association of India have

(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government have taken

SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of merger of circles by
BSNL;
(b) whether the merger of circles is in
line with the concept of a National Flat
Rate for mobile and fixed landline calls;

476

of  'One India' which was to be started
from January 26, 2006 has been postponed
due to some technical problems;
(d) if so, the details of problems faced
by his Ministry and by when the problems
would be sorted out and 'One India' concept
is going to be started;
(e) whether any players, private or
otherwise, are opposing 'One India'
concept; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?

BAL APTE:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-

TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the profits of MTNL and
BSNL have fallen sharply during the last
two years;
(b) the details of profits earned by these
PSUs during the last three years, year-wise;
